review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C bundle. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input, not a human-confirmed Decision; ready with no blocking reasons is therefore appropriate. This does not resolve DEC-001 for paired B, where a material unresolved Decision must block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the evidence stages, and the two stable task keys agree with the specification. The exact writable scope correctly contains the CORS implementation and its regression test; package exports and build configuration are inspection evidence, and the declaration build establishes that dist/types declarations are generated rather than separately maintained owners. The supplied test script and tsconfig establish distinct runtime and compile-time verification routes covering the scoped test file. TASK-VERIFY must remain independent, depend on TASK-IMPLEMENT, and cover all required acceptance criteria alongside implementation coverage. The allowed agents have the appropriate delivery roles, availability, membership, and relevant active project-scoped trusted capability claims; pending legacy claims and persona text are not needed to establish eligibility. The bounded invocation-local maxAge validation does not itself require shared-data or state capabilities. The proposed Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct original, normalized, manifest, and evaluation source digest domains. Repository, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budget, and policy fingerprints are supplied consistently. Historical project reuse is explicitly isolated from this bundle and does not provide candidate-derived expectations. I relied on the supplied Service binding and provenance assertions; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or provide human attestation.
